pages.title: Yunlai Swordmanship
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords$(br2)§lEffect: §r While held: +2.5 attack speed, +2.5 blocks attack range, melee damage ×1.10. On hit: 60% chance to unleash a 6-block sword qi along your line of sight, dealing 50% of the hit's damage.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Ancient Yunlai Swordmanship and other melee damage/growth enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
